name: droidpanel
description: A lightweight, zero-dependency web dashboard for Android app developers: mirror, screenshots, logcat, wireless ADB, app manager and one-click build/install.

scripts.check: node --check bin/droidpanel.mjs && for f in src/*.mjs shared/*.js ui/src/core/*.js ui/src/core/*/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && tsc -p tsconfig.json
